findings.problem: Browser redirect hops bypass the route callback on which the origin/path policy and35-request count depend.
findings.evidence: Installed primary Playwright coreBundle.js:37599-37610 detects redirectedFrom and automatically sends Fetch.continueRequest rather than constructing RouteImpl; types.d.ts:4441 documents the first-URL-only routing behavior for redirects.
findings.impact: A redirect from an admitted URL can make an uncounted request to an unapproved URL before later page assertions fail. No such redirect or credential leak was observed live; the finding is the source-supported gap in the claimed unconditional transport boundary.
findings.fix: Prevent redirect following before browser continuation. One narrow approach is bounded route.fetch with maxRedirects0, abort any3xx, and fulfill only nonredirect responses; an equivalent transport guard is acceptable. Preserve the35 admitted-request cap and verify redirect classification with pure tests.
